FN-PXNNRGG-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 35
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Russell Bedsole
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/05/2025
House Bill 35 as introduced would increase the obligations of the State General Fund,
beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, by $152,858 for each state death benefit payment paid to a
surviving beneficiary or dependent of a volunteer firefighter that dies as a result of a
work-related cancer, under certain conditions.
Page 1

FN-PXNNRGG-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 35
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Russell Bedsole
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/28/2025
House Bill 35 as passed the House of Representatives would increase the obligations of the
State General Fund, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, by $152,858 for each state death benefit
payment paid to a surviving beneficiary or dependent of a volunteer firefighter that dies as a
result of a work-related cancer, under certain conditions.
